request.purpose: We develop a new cigarette brand with lower tar and want to know where the lung-disease burden is highest to launch it there first.
request.question: What share of women has depression in each region?
definitions: Depression = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with F32.
Share = women with depression / all women in the region × 100, one decimal.
Report per region: women, women with depression and the share.
